# **Undergraduate, Diploma, HND, and Foundation Programme Catalogue: National Institute of Business Management (NIBM)**

## **Institutional Curriculum Architecture and Coverage Overview**

The academic catalogue of the National Institute of Business Management (NIBM) operates across eight instructional faculties and specialized centers distributed across eight campus locations in Sri Lanka: Colombo Campus, Rajagiriya Campus, Kirulapone National Innovation Centre (NIC), Kandy Campus, Peradeniya Kandy Innovation Centre (KIC), Kurunegala Campus, Galle Campus, and Matara Campus1. Across its web infrastructure, the institution maintains three distinct digital domains: the primary institutional portal (https\://nibm.ac.lk/), a dedicated subdomain for the NIBM School of Computing and Engineering (https\://soce.nibm.ac.lk/), and a staging environment (https\://development.nibm.ac.lk/)2.  
Because the institution spans eight faculties and centers, this catalogue completes the full programme extraction for the School of Computing (26 actual undergraduate degree, Higher National Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Diploma, and Foundation programmes found, alongside 4 certificate and transfer entry routes) and documents 6 additional programmes found across the Business Analytics Center, School of Business, and School of Language5. In total, 32 actual programmes found are documented with verified fee structures, entry criteria, durations, and campus allocations, counted separately from 14 directory pages and 4 preliminary certificate or transfer entry routes3. The remaining seven faculties and centers are catalogued for subsequent extraction1.  
A structural examination of the programmes found reveals that NIBM does not organize its undergraduate degrees as monolithic three- or four-year blocks; instead, it utilizes a nested, step-ladder qualification architecture8. Under this framework, the first year of an undergraduate degree is taught and certificated locally as an NIBM Diploma or Advanced Diploma, while the second year in most pathways is certificated as an NIBM Higher National Diploma (HND)8. Only in the third year (for three-year AI and Data Science degrees), the second and third years (for three-year Creative Multimedia and English/TESOL degrees), or the third and fourth years (for four-year computing degrees) does the student transition to modules awarded by an international partner university—specifically Coventry University in the United Kingdom or Limkokwing University of Creative Technology in Malaysia8. This modular design creates two parallel entry and pricing dynamics: students may enroll directly into a standalone one-year NIBM Diploma or HND and exit with a local qualification, or they may enroll in the overarching degree pathway and progress into the partner-awarded years, where annual tuition increases substantially9.

## **A. Programme Tables (Programmes Found)**

To preserve clarity across NIBM's qualification framework, the 32 programmes found are organized into two tables: Table A1 covers the 26 programmes found within the School of Computing (7 Undergraduate Degrees, 6 Higher National Diplomas, 1 Advanced Diploma, 9 Diplomas, and 3 Foundation Programmes), and Table A2 covers the 6 additional programmes found in the Business Analytics Center, School of Business, and School of Language5. All fees are local Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR) fees as published on official NIBM pages; international or overseas-transfer fee schedules are not published on these pages6.

## **B. Programme Notes, Entry Routes, and Data Discrepancies**

### **B1. Nested Qualification Structure, Campus Specialization, and Awarding Body Separation**

An evaluation of NIBM's undergraduate degree architecture demonstrates that its bachelor's programmes operate as multi-stage nested pathways in which NIBM awards the intermediate qualifications before the foreign partner university awards the final degree8. Within the four-year computing pathways centered at the Colombo Campus—specifically the BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Data Science, BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Applied Artificial Intelligence, BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Software Engineering, BSc (Hons) in Ethical Hacking and Network Security, and BSc (Hons) in Information Technology for Business—Year 01 is delivered full-time or part-time as an NIBM Diploma (Diploma in Software Engineering, Diploma in Network Engineering, or Diploma in Computer System Design), and Year 02 is delivered as an NIBM Higher National Diploma (HND in Software Engineering, HND in Network Engineering, or HND in Information Systems), with NIBM awarding the respective Diploma and HND certificates upon completion of each stage14. Years 03 and 04 are subsequently delivered in part-time mode and lead to the bachelor's degree awarded by Coventry University in the United Kingdom15. While the nibm.ac.lk course page for BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Data Science describes the qualification as a UK degree offered in collaboration with a partner university without printing the partner's name in the text block14, all sibling four-year computing specializations sharing the identical fee and module structure explicitly identify Coventry University as the awarding body15.  
In contrast to the four-year Colombo pathways, NIBM delivers three-year accelerated degree structures at its innovation hubs and regional centers8. The three-year BSc (Hons) in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence (taught at Peradeniya KIC and Matara) and the three-year BSc (Hons) in Data Science (taught at Kirulapone NIC, Peradeniya KIC, and Matara) structure Year 01 as an NIBM Diploma or Advanced Diploma and Year 02 as an NIBM HND, followed by a single final year (Year 03, priced at LKR 1,000,000 in course fees) awarded by Coventry University8. Conversely, in the three-year BA (Hons) in Creative Multimedia (at Colombo and Peradeniya KIC) and BA (Hons.) English and TESOL (at Colombo, Kirulapone NIC, and Peradeniya KIC), only Year 01 is an NIBM qualification (Advanced Diploma in Advertising and Multimedia or Diploma in English for Professionals), whereas both Year 02 and Year 03 are awarded by Limkokwing University of Creative Technology in Malaysia or Coventry University in the United Kingdom, respectively9. Across the School of Computing and Engineering, official pages for BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Software Engineering, BSc (Hons) in Information Technology for Business, and BA (Hons) in Creative Multimedia also state that SOCE curricula are undergoing a formal review, with revised curricula taking effect from the 27.1 intake15.  
![][image2]

### **B2. Partially Truncated Entry Criteria and Preliminary Entry Routes**

On several NIBM programme pages, the primary G.C.E. A/L or O/L entry option text is partially truncated in the web page preview blocks, whereas the alternative O/L and NIBM Foundation/Certificate entry options are stated in full6. Specifically, on the pages for BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Data Science14 and BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Applied Artificial Intelligence24, only the O/L Option (having sat for G.C.E. A/L in Mathematics, Science, or Technology with ICT and passed G.C.E. O/L with at least 5 credits including "B" passes for Mathematics and Science/ICT and a "C" pass for English) and the NIBM Certificate Option are displayed in full, although sibling four-year degrees on the identical template specify an A/L Option of at least 2 passes at G.C.E. A/L in Mathematics, Science, or Technology with ICT15. For Diploma in Software Engineering (Full Time)21, Diploma in Network Engineering (Full Time)36, and Diploma in Management Information Systems (Part Time)39, the A/L Option specifies a minimum of 3 passes at G.C.E. A/L, but the remainder of the A/L stream line is truncated in the page summary; prospective students entering solely via A/L passes without relying on the O/L or NIBM Foundation options should therefore confirm stream eligibility with the institution. Similarly, on the Foundation Programme for Bachelor's Degree page under the School of Business, the English language remediation requirement is published in full—stipulating that applicants without a pass in G.C.E. O/L English Language must obtain at least 4.5 in IELTS or complete NIBM's Certificate Course in English Language—while the baseline O/L credit count is omitted6.  
Furthermore, NIBM utilizes four short-term Certificate and Transfer programmes as formal admission pathways ("NIBM Option") into its Diplomas and Undergraduate Degrees11. To maintain strict separation between actual target qualifications and preliminary entry routes, these four programmes are excluded from the 32 programmes counted in Section A and are documented in the reference table below:

### **B3. Work Experience Requirement Conflict in Diploma in Network Engineering (Part Time)**

On the official programme page for Diploma in Network Engineering (Part Time) (https\://nibm.ac.lk/course/diploma-in-network-engineering-part-time), Option 1 of the entry requirements contains an internal contradiction regarding the length of required work experience37. The third sub-clause under Option 1 states that an applicant may qualify by having *"Passed G.C.E O/L with Five Credits including Mathematics and English With minimum 6 months of work experience"*, yet this clause is immediately followed by an overarching requirement specifying *"WITH One-year relevant work experience"*37. Prospective applicants applying through the G.C.E. O/L route should verify directly with NIBM whether 6 months or 1 year of work experience is enforced.

### **B4. Fee and Duration Conflict in Higher National Diploma in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence**

A substantial discrepancy in fee structure, duration, and study mode exists between the standalone programme page for the Higher National Diploma in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence (https\://nibm.ac.lk/course/higher-national-diploma-in-computer-science-with-artificial-intelligence) and the overarching degree page for the BSc (Hons) in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence (https\://nibm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-computerscience-with-ai)16. On the standalone HND page, the programme is presented as a 2-year Full-Time qualification at Peradeniya (KIC) with a course fee of LKR 850,000 plus a registration fee of LKR 5,000, and its published curriculum lists both Year 1 Diploma modules and Year 2 HND modules—despite stating under Entry Requirements that applicants must have *"Successfully completed a Diploma in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence"*33. Conversely, on the BSc (Hons) in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence page, Year 02 (Higher National Diploma in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence) is structured as a 1-year Part-Time stage priced at LKR 450,000 in course fees plus a LKR 5,000 registration fee, following Year 01 (Diploma in Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence, priced at LKR 350,000 in course fees plus a LKR 5,000 registration fee)16.

### **B5. Cross-Domain Intake Date, Department, and Campus Listing Discrepancies**

Cross-referencing NIBM's primary domain (nibm.ac.lk) against the School of Computing and Engineering subdomain (soce.nibm.ac.lk) and internal page metadata reveals three sets of minor administrative inconsistencies14. First, for both BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Data Science and BSc (Hons) Computer Science with Applied Artificial Intelligence, the nibm.ac.lk course pages list the Colombo Campus Year 03 commencement date as 14th October 2026, whereas the corresponding soce.nibm.ac.lk course pages list the next Year 03 commencement (designated Batch 26.2P) as October 13, 202614. Second, on nibm.ac.lk, the top page banners for Degree Foundation in Multimedia (https\://nibm.ac.lk/course/degree-foundation-in-multimedia) and BSc (Hons) in Information Technology for Business (https\://nibm.ac.lk/course/bsc-hons-information-technology-for-business) display stray header text reading PRODUCTIVITY & QUALITY CENTER, whereas their structured department metadata fields and the SOCE subdomain explicitly assign both programmes to the SCHOOL OF COMPUTING18. Third, five programme pages list a narrower set of campuses in their upper metadata summary than in their lower "Commencement" intake schedules: Foundation Programme for Bachelor's Degree lists only Rajagiriya, Kandy, and Galle in its header banner but publishes 2026 commencement dates for Kurunegala (06th April 2026\) and Matara (December 2026\)6; Degree Foundation in Computer Science lists Colombo, Matara, Kurunegala, and Galle in its header but includes Kandy (Pending) under commencement44; Diploma in Software Engineering (Full Time) lists Colombo, Kandy, Kurunegala, and Galle in its header but schedules a Matara intake for 08th October 202621; HND in Software Engineering (Full Time) lists Colombo and Kurunegala in its header but includes Kandy (Pending) and Galle (Pending) under commencement20; and HND in Network Engineering (Full Time) lists only Colombo Campus in its header but includes Kurunegala (Pending) under commencement29.

### **C2. Remaining Faculties for Subsequent Research Requests**

While the School of Computing has been thoroughly catalogued in this report, NIBM's remaining seven faculties and specialized centers require dedicated programme extraction in subsequent research passes1. Across the institution, these remaining units comprise the School of Business (from which 4 programmes are documented in Table A2, leaving 5 Coventry University undergraduate degrees and multiple feeder Advanced Diplomas and Diplomas in management, human resources, marketing, finance, digital banking, and logistics to be extracted), the School of Engineering (with 3 quantity surveying and electro-mechanical engineering programmes discovered on the SOCE portal in Table C1 and additional engineering degrees pending), the School of Language (from which 1 degree is documented in Table A2, with the BA (Hons) in English Studies and standalone language diplomas pending), the School of Design (with 2 programmes discovered in Table C1), the School of Humanities (with 2 degrees in psychology and multimedia journalism discovered in Table C1), the Business Analytics Center (from which the BSc (Hons) in Data Science is documented in Table A2, leaving the Foundation Course in Data Science and standalone diploma pages pending), and the Productivity & Quality Center (which is listed across NIBM's Degree, HND, Advanced Diploma, and Foundation directories)1. Researchers conducting subsequent passes should also note a technical limitation on the faculty overview page https\://nibm.ac.lk/faculties/school-of-computing: the category links for Degree, HND, Diploma, and Foundation programmes point to static CloudFront SVG image assets (https\://d1lmq142maiv1z.cloudfront.net/Asset\_4\_70d58cbe6a.svg, Asset\_5\_808be99df1.svg, Asset\_7\_d1653eec88.svg, and Asset\_10\_ec76f3838b.svg) that contain no text course listings, meaning that future extraction must directly query the /course/ path on nibm.ac.lk and /courses/ path on soce.nibm.ac.lk5.

## **Conclusion: Structural Synthesis for UniPedia Database Integration**

When ingesting NIBM's programme data into UniPedia's relational database, database architects must account for three structural characteristics demonstrated by the evidence8. Because NIBM's one-year Diplomas (LKR 350,000) and one-year HNDs (LKR 300,000 to LKR 450,000) serve simultaneously as standalone exit qualifications awarded by NIBM and as the initial years of the four-year Coventry University and three-year Limkokwing University degrees, UniPedia must maintain separate database records for the standalone NIBM diplomas and HNDs versus the multi-year partner-awarded bachelor's degrees, linking them through prerequisite pathway relations rather than merging them into a single entity15. At the geographic level, regional campuses in Kandy, Kurunegala, Galle, and Matara predominantly deliver Year 01 Full-Time and Part-Time Diplomas and 6-month Foundations, whereas the final Coventry University awarding years for four-year computing degrees are centralized at the Colombo Campus in Part-Time mode, and the three-year AI and Data Science degrees operate out of Kirulapone NIC, Peradeniya KIC, and Matara8. Consequently, UniPedia's user interface should bind study modes and intake schedules at the granular campus-by-programme level rather than assuming uniform institutional delivery, while subsequent data collection passes prioritize the School of Business and the School of Engineering to complete NIBM's multi-faculty catalogue4.
